purpose: The wallet service manages customer wallets, allowing top-ups from funding sources, transfers between wallets, and profile updates.

components.name: wallet-core
components.evidence: the wallet keeps the balance of every customer wallet, lets the customer top up from a funding source, send money to another wallet and change the profile (name, phone, adress).

components.name: wallet-db
components.evidence: wallet-db which is the PostgreSQL with balances and transactions.

components.name: Mobile API Gateway
components.evidence: the mobile app talks to the Mobile API Gateway, the gateway checks the token with Keycloak (TBD which realm for the new customers) and sends the request to wallet-core.

components.name: Keycloak
components.evidence: the gateway checks the token with Keycloak (TBD which realm for the new customers).

flows.evidence: the gateway checks the token with Keycloak (TBD which realm for the new customers) and sends the request to wallet-core.
wallet-core reads and writes wallet-db which is the PostgreSQL with balances and transactions.
